userInput:
the ui for the boxes shows unpleasant behavior. When you load the ui with flat options then you see at the bottom of the 'selected mixins' panel the local uploaded mixins. URL for flat options: http://localhost:8080/?input=boxes_aac_example.yaml&options=options.yaml

If you load grouped options the upload entry and the available local uploaded mixins are not displayed. Here the link for the grouped options: http://localhost:8080/?input=boxes_aac_example.yaml&options=options_groups.yaml

Can you see the bug?

alternatives.name: Inject Uploaded Mixins into Grouped Groups Array
alternatives.description: Modify ensureUploadOptionsInCombo() to also inject uploaded mixins into toolbarComboState.groups when in grouped mode. Create a synthetic 'Uploads' group at the end of the groups array containing all uploaded mixin items.
pros: Fixes the root cause: grouped rendering will see uploaded mixins
Minimal change - only modify ensureUploadOptionsInCombo to also update groups
Works seamlessly with existing group rendering, collapse, filtering
cons: Need to handle the 'Uploads' sentinel option (__upload__) as a special group item
Need to handle the upload button rendering within the group (similar to flat mode approach)
Group select-all checkbox behavior needs special handling for uploads group

alternatives.name: Fall Back to Flat Rendering for Uploads in Grouped Mode
alternatives.description: Modify renderGroupedToolbarComboDropdown to read from the hidden <select> element as a fallback source for uploaded mixins, appending them after all YAML groups.
pros: Simple reading logic - just add a second pass over select.options
cons: Mixes two data sources (groups + select) making the rendering logic confusing
Uploads would appear outside the group structure, breaking the visual grouping paradigm
Still doesn't render the upload button icon properly (requires createComboOptionRow handling)

alternatives.name: Restructure: Separate Uploads from Groups Completely
alternatives.description: Keep a separate state variable for uploaded mixins and render them as a footer bar below all groups, rather than integrating them into the groups structure.
pros: Clean separation of concerns - YAML groups vs user uploads
No risk of breaking group logic
cons: Requires new UI component (footer bar) - more code changes
Different UX than what works in flat mode
Uploads would be visually separated from other mixins
More complex than necessary for this bug

recommendation.approach: Inject Uploaded Mixins into Grouped Groups Array (Alternative 1)
recommendation.rationale:
The bug is a simple data source mismatch:

**Root Cause:** In `renderGroupedToolbarComboDropdown` (line 895-985), the function iterates over `toolbarComboState.groups` which was populated from the YAML parsing at line 2803. The function `ensureUploadOptionsInCombo()` (line 1466) only adds uploaded mixins to the hidden `<select>` element but NEVER injects them into `toolbarComboState.groups`. In flat mode, `renderFlatToolbarComboDropdown` reads from the `<select>` element via `getToolbarComboOptions()`, so uploaded mixins appear. In grouped mode, the groups array is the sole data source and it never sees uploaded mixins.

**Why this approach is best:**
1. **Targets the exact bug** - Just need to make `ensureUploadOptionsInCombo` also update `toolbarComboState.groups` when in grouped mode
2. **Minimal code change** - A few lines in `ensureUploadOptionsInCombo` to also populate groups
3. **Preserves existing UX** - Uploaded mixins appear in the dropdown just like in flat mode
4. **Uses existing infrastructure** - `createComboOptionRow` already handles the `__upload__` sentinel and renders the upload button icon (lines 996-1010)

**Implementation:**
- In `ensureUploadOptionsInCombo`, after updating the hidden `<select>`, also check if `toolbarComboState.isGroupedMode`
- If grouped mode, build or update an 'Uploads' group at the end of `toolbarComboState.groups`
- This group contains items from `getUploadedMixins()` plus the `__upload__` sentinel
- The existing `renderGroupedToolbarComboDropdown` will automatically render them since it iterates over all groups
- The existing `createComboOptionRow` will render the upload button icon when it sees the `__upload__` sentinel value

notes: The bug was introduced when grouped UI was added - uploaded mixins were only wired to the flat path (via <select> element reading).
The upload button icon rendering already exists in createComboOptionRow (line 996-1010) - it just never gets triggered in grouped mode because the __upload__ sentinel never appears in any group.

All upload infrastructure (promptForUploadedMixin, ensureUploadOptionsInCombo, triggerToolbarComboUpload) works correctly in flat mode - the issue is purely that grouped mode bypasses the <select> reading path.
The fix should also handle the 'Uploads' group checkbox behavior (select-all should work correctly for uploaded mixins).
